items.text: Guest complaint log — Ref CR-4471: Ms. Halvorsen reports the Harbourline Suites room was not the sea-view category booked, and the front desk offered a courtyard room instead. Assigned to Tier 2 for follow-up.
The chatbot resolved 62% of pricing questions without escalation last quarter, up from 48% in Q1 — see the attached metrics deck for the full breakdown by channel.

Meeting notes, 14 March — Booking Flow Review. Priya walked through the revised hotel booking confirmation screen and flagged two open items: the rate breakdown still hides resort fees until step three, and the cancellation window text conflicts with the supplier contract for the Bellweather properties. Tom agreed to pull the contract language and circulate it by Friday. The group also discussed whether the automated rebooking tool should be paused during the peak-season freeze; no decision was reached. Next meeting is set for 21 March, same room.

Insurance claim summary — Claim IC-20983, policyholder R. Okonkwo. Trip to Porto cancelled after a family bereavement; claimant submitted booking receipts from Costa Verde Travel and a death certificate. Assessor notes the cancellation occurred 11 days before departure, within the covered window. Reimbursement recommended for the non-refundable hotel portion (£412.60) and the rail tickets (£88.00); the airline credit is excluded as it was already refunded in voucher form. File forwarded to payments for settlement.
The booking confirmation email for reservation HB-77213 was sent to the wrong address because the guest's profile had a stale contact record from a 2021 migration.

Supplier performance review — Q2 2024, prepared by the Partnerships team.

Overall booking volume with Northgate Stays rose 9% quarter on quarter, but the average handling time for amendments increased to 4.2 days. Northgate attributes the delay to their new reservation system rollout; a fix is expected by mid-July. The table below summarises the key figures.

| Metric | Q1 | Q2 | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bookings | 3,410 | 3,717 | +9.0% |
| Amendment handling (days) | 3.1 | 4.2 | +1.1 |
| Cancellations | 212 | 198 | -6.6% |
| Complaint rate | 1.8% | 2.1% | +0.3pp |

A recurring theme in the complaint sample was unclear rate descriptions at the point of sale, particularly for rooms that include breakfast. The content team has drafted revised copy for the 40 most-booked properties and will test it before wider rollout. Separately, the automated fraud-screening tool flagged a small batch of bookings for manual review, all of which cleared within 48 hours. No financial loss was recorded.

Actions: (1) Partnerships to schedule a call with Northgate on the amendment backlog; (2) Content to deliver revised rate copy for sign-off; (3) Finance to confirm that the reconciliation file for June was accepted.
Policy TP-12: hotel booking changes requested within 24 hours of arrival must be routed to the duty manager, not handled by the standard self-service flow.
Claim IC-20983 moved to 'awaiting documents' — missing item: proof of payment for the rail tickets dated 2 May.
The customer complaint (ticket #88214) concerns a hotel booking at the Larkspur Inn where the listed check-in time did not match what the property advertised online.
A former support agent noted that the automated assistant tended to misread multi-city itineraries, so the team added a manual check step for those cases in the booking workflow.
